listing.name: God of War: Sons of Sparta (Sons Of Sparta PS5 Native)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, already prepared God of War: Sons of Sparta Windows copy through its waiting upstream launcher. Your own exact PS5 data and generated game remain upstream-managed; preserve _sd and the complete prepared folder.
listing.original_game_title: God of War: Sons of Sparta

steps.title: Finish exact upstream preparation
steps.instruction: Use a complete copy and components you are independently permitted to use, with your own legally obtained decrypted PS5 PPSA28997 version 01.008.001 data: your decrypted eboot.bin/eboot.elf, sce_sys, sce_module, Media and the complete remaining game files. Other regions, versions, updates and repacked dumps remain untested. Complete upstream relinking, shader preparation, settings and a prepared layout outside Portcove. Keep independent originals. This guide obtains or executes no game, relinker, firmware, key or helper and does not authorize decryption or credential operations.

steps.title: Keep the complete prepared Windows folder
steps.instruction: The inspected official Windows ZIP contains the AMD64 SonsOfSparta-PS5.exe launcher, tools/relinker.exe and matching libraries. The launcher is not by itself the complete game: upstream derives a separate Windows game executable from your own original x86-64 program. Keep that prepared output and all matching libraries beside the launcher. This is title-specific native relinking with reimplemented console services and Vulkan shaders, not a static translation of a different CPU or a generic PS5 emulator integration.

steps.title: Attach the waiting launcher
steps.instruction: Select SonsOfSparta-PS5.exe, set its complete prepared package folder as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the exact selected intent and request Play separately; use the upstream settings window/Play if shown. The selected launcher starts the prepared game child and waits for its normal exit. It can reprepare when originals, tools or preparation stamps change: finish such work outside the attached attempt first. Do not select a generated internal executable or relinker to bypass the supported entry. Normal waiting does not establish forced-stop quiescence or save flushing.

steps.title: Preserve actual player data and preparation
steps.instruction: Keep the complete _sd save folder beside the launcher, all game files, preparation/generated-runtime files, shader caches, logs, existing configuration and external paths. For Sons of Sparta also keep launcher.ini, _sd/GOWSOSSAVE999/GoW_SoS999.dat, prep/prepared.stamp and resolution.txt.old from upstream’s legacy settings conversion when present. This guide makes no settings, save conversion, migration, cleanup or backup changes; preserve old and new copies independently.

steps.title: Separate component terms from the original game
steps.instruction: Retain the project GPLv2 notice, AnyPS5 and all library/component notices. These do not grant rights to the original God of War: Sons of Sparta executable, shaders or assets; use only a complete copy you are independently permitted to use. No other PS5 game or original PC edition is admitted by this title-specific route.

steps.title: Maintain outside the attachment
steps.instruction: Quit the actual game normally and wait for the launcher to return before upstream replacement or data operations. Preserve independent recovery copies and review/relink changed executable bytes. Requirements and limits include Vulkan 1.3; selected upstream reports NVIDIA testing only, incomplete whole-game coverage and possible shader, loading and crash problems. These remain upstream claims; no native gameplay, complete-game, save/reload, installed-app or Supported acceptance is asserted. Removing registration preserves external files; managed install/update/rollback/backup/removal remain unavailable.

warnings: Keep exact original and prepared-game files plus _sd. The published launcher and relinker alone are not a complete playable game; other versions and native acceptance remain unqualified.
